name: Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani
current_role: Emir of Qatar (since June 2013); oversees the Qatar Investment Authority
profile: Born 1980 in Doha, Tamim became Emir in 2013 when his father abdicated, after a decade as heir apparent. As head of state he oversees Qatar's sovereign wealth fund, the Qatar Investment Authority; his listed wealth reflects that role rather than a business he built. His reign is defined by the 2022 FIFA World Cup, Qatar National Vision 2030 and Qatar's role as a diplomatic mediator.
interesting_fact: In 2005 he founded Oryx Qatar Sports Investments, the vehicle that later bought Paris Saint-Germain F.C.
deep_cut_fact: He was elected an IOC member at the 113th IOC Session in February 2002, aged 21. He also chaired the organising committee of the 2006 Doha Asian Games, which was the first edition attended by every member country.
notes: Reigning head of state, so a podcast request would realistically go through the Amiri Diwan or Qatar's Government Communications Office (gco.gov.qa). A more practical guest from QIA might be its CEO. His net worth figure is an old Hurun 2016 estimate.
